seo.description: Interactive map of Madrid 360 and the Low Emission Zones (ZBE Distrito Centro, Plaza Elíptica, M-30, OCR enforcement cameras and a DGT sticker simulator).
seo.keywords: Madrid 360, ZBE Madrid, Madrid Central, ZBEDEP Distrito Centro, Plaza Elíptica ZBE, M-30 low emission zone, Madrid ZBE cameras, Madrid DGT stickers

residency.madridResident: Resident in the city of Madrid

centro.ceroMessage: Driving and SER parking allowed, with no charge and no time limit.
centro.ecoMessage: Free access. On-street parking (SER) for up to 2 hours. In public car parks, no limit.
centro.residentMessage: As a resident registered in Distrito Centro, you can enter and park in your neighbourhood.
centro.motorcycleMessage: Motorcycles and mopeds with a B or C sticker can enter freely between 07:00 and 22:00.
centro.parkingMessage: You must park in a public car park or a contracted private garage. On-street parking is prohibited.
centro.transitMessage: Vehicles with a B or C sticker cannot enter simply to pass through (transit) or to park on the street (SER).
centro.historicMessage: Permitted only if the vehicle was already registered in the district before 2021, or if it is transporting people with reduced mobility (PMR).
centro.deniedMessage: Vehicles without a sticker (A) are not allowed to enter, subject to a fine of {{ amount }} ({{ earlyAmount }} for early payment).

eliptica.defaultMessage: No ZBE-specific restrictions for CERO, ECO, C and B stickers.
eliptica.residentMessage: Vehicle registered within the defined perimeter of Plaza Elíptica.
eliptica.deniedMessage: Access and movement prohibited for vehicles without a sticker (A). Penalty: {{ amount }}.

m30.defaultMessage: Driving permitted on the M-30 and the inner streets under the general traffic rules and the SER scheme.
m30.residentTitle: Permitted (IVTM paid in the city of Madrid)
m30.residentMessage: Permitted only if the car pays the Motor Vehicle Tax (IVTM) in the city of Madrid.
m30.deniedTitle: Driving prohibited on the M-30 and in the inner area
m30.deniedMessage: A vehicles not registered in the city are prohibited from driving on the M-30 and in the inner area. Penalty: {{ amount }}.

municipio.defaultMessage: Driving permitted on every road within the municipality of Madrid.
municipio.residentMessage: A cars registered in Madrid with the IVTM up to date.
municipio.deniedMessage: Driving prohibited on any public road within the municipality of Madrid. Penalty: {{ amount }}.

getafe.freeMessage: CERO and ECO vehicles can drive and park without restrictions in the centre of Getafe.
getafe.residentMessage: Vehicles listed on the Getafe municipal register have free access to the town centre.
getafe.parkingTitle: Access allowed when heading to a car park
getafe.parkingMessage: Non-residents may enter if they are heading to public car parks or to reserved parking spaces.
getafe.transitMessage: B and C vehicles that are not registered in Getafe must justify their stay or destination within the Getafe perimeter.
getafe.restrictedMessage: Only residents' vehicles with authorisation, or PMR vehicles, can enter without a sticker.
getafe.deniedMessage: Vehicles without a sticker (A) are prohibited from driving within the perimeter of the Getafe ZBE.

cero.label: 0 emissions
cero.description: 100% electric vehicles (BEV), plug-in hybrids (PHEV) with a range of 40 km or more, and fuel-cell vehicles.

eco.label: ECO
eco.description: Non-plug-in hybrids (HEV), plug-in hybrids with less than 40 km of range, mild hybrids (MHEV) and gas vehicles (LPG/CNG).

c.label: C (green)
c.description: Petrol cars and light vans registered from {{ petrolDate }} (Euro 4, 5 and 6) and diesel vehicles from {{ dieselDate }} (Euro 6).

b.label: B (yellow)
b.description: Petrol cars registered between {{ petrolDate }} and 2005 (Euro 3), and diesel cars registered between 2006 and {{ dieselDate }} (Euro 4 and 5).

a.label: No sticker (A)
a.description: The most polluting vehicles: petrol vehicles registered before 2001 (pre-Euro 3) and diesel vehicles registered before 2006 (pre-Euro 4).

zbe-distrito-centro.name: ZBEDEP Distrito Centro (Madrid Central)
zbe-distrito-centro.description: Special Protection Low Emission Zone in the historic heart of Madrid. Strict access rules based on the environmental sticker, with compulsory parking.

rules.cero: Free access and free on-street parking (SER), with no charge and no time limit.
rules.eco: Free access. On-street parking (SER) for a maximum of 2 hours, or in underground car parks.
rules.c: Access only if you park in a public or contracted private car park, or with an invitation from a resident.
rules.b: Access only if you park in a public or contracted private car park, or with an invitation from a resident.
rules.a: Access completely prohibited except for residents registered before 2021, PMR and emergency services.

zbe-plaza-eliptica.name: ZBEDEP Plaza Elíptica
zbe-plaza-eliptica.description: Special Protection Low Emission Zone centred on the historic pollution hotspot of Usera and Carabanchel, around the A-42.

rules.cero: Free movement and parking with no ZBE-specific restrictions.
rules.eco: Free movement and parking with no ZBE-specific restrictions.
rules.c: Free movement and parking with no ZBE-specific restrictions.
rules.b: Free movement and parking with no ZBE-specific restrictions.
rules.a: Access completely prohibited, 24 hours a day, to A vehicles (no sticker), except registered residents or PMR transfers.

zbe-interior-m30.name: Madrid ZBE - Interior M-30
zbe-interior-m30.description: Area enclosed by the M-30 motorway ring, covering the 7 central districts of the city.

rules.cero: Free access and SER parking with no time limit.
rules.eco: Free access. Standard SER parking with a tariff discount.
rules.a: Cars without an environmental sticker that are not registered in Madrid are prohibited from driving on the M-30 and the inner streets.

zbe-municipio.name: Madrid ZBE (Whole Municipality)
zbe-municipio.description: Low Emission Zone covering the whole municipal area of Madrid (the 21 districts of the city).
zbe-municipio.lawReference: Sustainable Mobility Ordinance (OMS) art. 21 and the Traffic Act

rules.cero: Access and parking permitted without restriction.
rules.eco: Access and parking permitted without restriction.
rules.c: Access and parking permitted without restriction.
rules.b: Access and parking permitted without restriction.
rules.a: Access and driving prohibited if the vehicle is not registered in the city of Madrid and does not pay the IVTM to the City Council.

zbe-getafe.name: Getafe Centre ZBE
zbe-getafe.restrictionLevel: Regulated (CERO/ECO free; B/C with a destination or for residents)
zbe-getafe.description: Low Emission Zone in the town centre and historic quarter of Getafe, bounded by C/ Toledo, Sur, Ferrocarril and Juan de la Cierva.

rules.cero: Free access and parking with no restrictions.
rules.eco: Free access and parking with no restrictions.
rules.c: Access permitted for registered residents, vehicles heading to a car park or with authorisation.
rules.b: Access permitted for registered residents, vehicles heading to a car park or with authorisation.
rules.a: Access and driving prohibited except for registered residents and authorised PMR.

zbe-fuenlabrada.name: Fuenlabrada ZBE (Distrito Centro)
zbe-fuenlabrada.description: Low Emission Zone in the Distrito Centro of Fuenlabrada, with a general exemption for vehicles registered in the municipality.
zbe-fuenlabrada.lawReference: Sustainable Mobility and ZBE Ordinance of Fuenlabrada

rules.cero: Free access and movement with no restrictions.
rules.eco: Free access and movement with no restrictions.
rules.c: Access permitted for residents and for vehicles with a destination or a justified stay in the area.
rules.b: Access permitted for residents and for vehicles with a destination or a justified stay in the area.
rules.a: General restriction on through traffic for vehicles without a sticker that are not registered in Fuenlabrada.

zbe-alcorcon.name: Alcorcón Old Town ZBE
zbe-alcorcon.description: Low Emission Zone in the urban centre of Alcorcón, protecting the shopping and pedestrian area around Calle Mayor and Plaza de España.

rules.cero: Free access and parking with no restrictions.
rules.eco: Free access and parking with no restrictions.
rules.c: Free access for registered residents and vehicles heading into the zone.
rules.b: Free access for registered residents and vehicles heading into the zone.
rules.a: Through traffic restricted for vehicles without an environmental sticker that are not registered locally.

zbe-alcala.name: Alcalá de Henares Historic Centre ZBE
zbe-alcala.description: Low Emission Zone in the Historic Centre, a World Heritage Site. Restrictions are activated automatically during high-pollution episodes.
zbe-alcala.lawReference: Alcalá de Henares ZBE Regulatory Ordinance (BOCM 2025)

rules.cero: Free access and movement with no restrictions at any time.
rules.eco: Free access and movement with no restrictions at any time.
rules.c: Normal free movement; restrictions only during severe pollution episodes.
rules.b: Normal free movement; restrictions only during severe pollution episodes.
rules.a: Normal free movement unless the protocol is triggered by NO₂ exceeding 180 µg/m³.

zbe-alcobendas.name: Alcobendas ZBE (Distrito Centro)
zbe-alcobendas.description: Low Emission Zone in the historic and commercial core of Alcobendas, around Marquesa Viuda de Aldama and Av. de España.

rules.cero: Free access and movement with no restrictions.
rules.eco: Free access and movement with no restrictions.
rules.c: Free access and movement with no restrictions.
rules.b: Free access and movement with no restrictions.
rules.a: Driving prohibited for vehicles without an environmental sticker that are not registered locally.

zbe-mostoles.name: Móstoles ZBE (Área 20 central core)
zbe-mostoles.restrictionLevel: Residential Área 20 (restriction on vehicles without a sticker)
zbe-mostoles.description: Low Emission Zone and traffic calming across the Área 20 perimeter in Móstoles (C/ Cristo, Juan XXIII, Reyes Católicos, Ricardo Medem).

rules.cero: Free movement and parking with no restrictions.
rules.eco: Free movement and parking with no restrictions.
rules.c: Free access to car parks and for residents; free movement around the perimeter ring.
rules.b: Free access to car parks and for residents; free movement around the perimeter ring.
rules.a: Entry into the central core restricted except for registered residents and PMR.

zbe-parla.name: Parla Old Town ZBE
zbe-parla.description: Low Emission Zone in the historic and commercial quarter of Parla, regulating access around Calle Real, Calle Pinto and Calle Torrejón.

rules.cero: Free access and parking with no restrictions.
rules.eco: Free access and parking with no restrictions.
rules.c: Access permitted for residents, car parks and commercial authorisations.
rules.b: Access permitted for residents, car parks and commercial authorisations.
rules.a: Driving into the area prohibited except for registered residents and essential vehicles.

zbe-rivas.name: Rivas-Vaciamadrid ZBE
zbe-rivas.description: Low Emission Zone in Rivas, protecting school areas and residential streets with heavy foot traffic.
zbe-rivas.lawReference: Rivas Sustainable School Mobility Plan and ZBE

rules.a: Access control and time limits in signposted school areas.
